title: Modine to Become Modexus Solutions, Marking Next Chapter as Diversified Thermal Management Solutions Company
summary: Modine (NYSE: MOD), a diversified global leader in thermal management technology and solutions, today announced that it will become Modexus Solutions after completing the spinoff of its Performance Technologies business and merger with Gentherm. Under applicable law, the name change will be subject to approval by Modine's shareholders. Once effective, Modexus Solutions will trade on the New York Stock Exchange under Modine's current ticker symbol, "MOD."
